ruleDefinitions.name: Disable Windows Defender Functionalities Via Registry Keys
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when attackers or tools disable Windows Defender functionalities via the Windows registry Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Policies\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\ Security\\ Center\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Policies\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\.*")) AND (((registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisableAntiSpyware$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisableAntiVirus$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisableBehaviorMonitoring$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisableBlockAtFirstSeen$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisableEnhancedNotifications$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisableIOAVProtection$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisableOnAccessProtection$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisableRealtimeMonitoring$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisableScanOnRealtimeEnable$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisableScriptScanning$")) AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000001\)") OR ((registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisallowExploitProtectionOverride$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\Features\\\\TamperProtection$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\MpEngine\\\\MpEnablePus$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\PUAProtection$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\Signature\\ Update\\\\ForceUpdateFromMU$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\SpyNet\\\\SpynetReporting$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\SpyNet\\\\SubmitSamplesConsent$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\ Exploit\\ Guard\\\\Controlled\\ Folder\\ Access\\\\EnableControlledFolderAccess$")) AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000000\)")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Symantec\\\\Symantec\\ Endpoint\\ Protection\\\\") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\sepWscSvc64\\\.exe$")))
